intro.text: Softcom is a technology and innovation company with {19 years} of experience building for public institutions, private organisations and development enablers. We help organisations think through what they want to achieve, then bring together the technology, people and processes to make it happen.

image.alt: Lagos at dusk across the lagoon, a fisherman in a canoe

mission.title: Stronger organisations build a more prosperous society.
mission.text: We build the technology and capabilities that help Organisations work better, decide better and serve the people who depend on them.

items.title: Digital Infrastructure
items.text: We build the digital rails that enable people and organisations to access services, connect and transact. These systems provide a common foundation through which many participants can operate, repeatedly and at scale.

image.alt: An attendant at a filling station completing a digital payment at dusk

items.title: Applied Intelligence
items.text: Our intelligence systems connect fragmented information and help organisations examine it in depth. Across documents, records and datasets, including market data, our technology helps people investigate activity, understand relationships, track changes and identify what needs attention.

image.alt: An analyst in an intelligence operations room overlooking the city at night

items.title: Powering Initiatives
items.text: We bring technology, people and processes together to deliver complex initiatives. We design how an initiative will operate, put the required systems in place and coordinate the activities needed to reach its intended beneficiaries.

image.alt: A field officer enrolling a beneficiary in a rural community

audiences.title: Who we work with
audiences.intro: Different organisations have different ambitions. Some have a precise requirement, others have a challenge to work through or a possibility to explore.

items.title: Public Institutions
items.text: We work with public institutions on the technology and systems needed to serve people, support oversight and coordinate delivery. Our approach considers the mandate, the operating environment and the people the solution must reach.

items.title: Private Organisations
items.text: We help businesses apply technology to the priorities that shape their performance. From enterprise systems to intelligence and digital services, we connect technical capability with the organisation’s commercial ambitions.

items.title: Development Enablers
items.text: Local understanding, coordinated implementation and visibility into results are essential to development work. Our technology and delivery expertise help development organisations reach intended beneficiaries, follow progress and respond to what they learn.

items.label: Technology
items.title: Technology to make it happen.
items.text: Our engineers consider the organisation’s existing systems, operating conditions and future requirements. These inform what to build, what to integrate and how the different parts should work together.

items.label: Expertise
items.title: Expertise to make it work.
items.text: Putting technology to work requires clear responsibilities, prepared teams and processes that support its use. Depending on the engagement, our involvement can extend to change management, ongoing operations and impact assessment.

items.label: People
items.title: People behind the work.
items.text: Softcom’s experience lives in its people: the knowledge they have developed, the challenges they have worked through and the standards they bring to each engagement.
